notes: CAMO GRIND: every gun now has its own camo challenges - open the LOCKER, pick a gun and go to CHALLENGES
8 MILITARY camos per gun: kills, headshots, longshots, hip-fire kills (crouched kills for snipers and marksman rifles) and double kills with that gun
MASTERY: all 8 unlock GOLD for that gun. GOLD on every gun in a class unlocks DIAMOND for the whole class. DIAMOND in every class unlocks NOVA for every gun
Progress counts in every mode, offline and online, with a banner when you unlock one. The weapon grid shows each gun's progress
